headline: Haaland Holds The Balance For 123
deck: Man City v Sunderland Sunday, test4's front three of Foden, Isidor and Cherki against 123's Haaland with a 6-26 tie already lopsided.
body:
The 6-26 gap is real, but ninety minutes here can widen it or start the climb back. test4 loads this fixture: Foden, E.Le Fée, Isidor and Cherki all in the same match, four men chasing the twenty-point hole that 123 opened up. Against them 123 leans on Reinildo, Hume and above all Haaland, the one man who can turn a lopsided tie into a rout in a single afternoon.

The smaller duel carries its own weight. test31, six points back on testf, sends Ballard alone into a fixture where testf answer with Rúben, N.Angulo and Xhaka. One defender against three, the two-point chase now a six-point one, and testf's spread of men leaving Ballard to do the work by himself. Guéhi and Semenyo for test1, Roefs for test211, Ndiaye for test3 all watch on with no tie riding on them here.
